question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the word 'vivid' from the given sentence:**

In my murky memory lane, I still could vividly apprehend and envision the pictures of Nischindipu while reading Bibhutibhushan Bandyopadhyay's "Pather Panchali"
solution:
The correct answer is **"murky".**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• A word that denotes **the opposite of another word** is known as an **antonym**.
 
• Being **vivid **means **appearing to be full of life or freshness**. (जीवंत)
 
• When you say something is **murky**, you're implying that the **specifics are unclear or that it's challenging to comprehend.** (संदेहास्पद; फ़ीका; उदास)
 
• Therefore, **option 3) **is the correct answer.
